title: Shared and genetically distinct Zea mays transcriptome responses to ongoing and past low temperature exposure
genotypes: CG60 (more cold tolerant: biomass ratio cold/control 0.54, smaller Fv/Fm drop); CG102 (less tolerant: ratio 0.47); short-season inbreds from different breeding pools
tissue: second leaf blade (whole blade from ligule, includes meristem and elongating cells); 5 plants pooled per sample
stage_age: V2 (two leaves with visible ligules), 13 d after planting at start of cold; sampled at 14 d (cold) and 17 d (recovery)
growth_system: growth chamber; Turface:ProMix (1:1) with daily nutrient solution; 16 h photoperiod; PPFD 650 µmol m-2 s-1; RH 60/70% day/night; ramp-type temperature protocol; location NR
cold_treatments: 14/2 °C day/night for 3 d, then recovery at 24/14 °C; plants sampled in cold at 14 °C
control_temperature: 24/14 °C day/night (control plants planted 1 and 3 d later to match developmental stage at sampling)
other_factors: genotype x temperature (G x E); ongoing cold (D1) vs past cold exposure (D4)
timepoints_duration: D1 = 24 h into the 3 d cold treatment; D4 = 24 h into recovery (17 d after planting); matched controls at each time
bio_reps: 3 (pools of 5 plants; experiment repeated three times)
n_libraries: 24 (2 genotypes x 2 treatments x 2 sampling times x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE100 (8.4-12 M read pairs per sample); aligned to B73 AGPv3
accession: PRJNA492469 (BioProject/EVA listing with the same title found by web search; accession number not present in extracted full text)
key_finding: Large shared core cold response; fewer genes persist after recovery; genotype-specific DNA replication, ROS and anthocyanin responses.
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession from web search
notes: Accession should be confirmed on NCBI; tolerant/sensitive designation based on biomass and fluorescence, not field data

title: Biochemical and Transcriptional Regulation of Membrane Lipid Metabolism in Maize Leaves under Low Temperature
genotypes: He 344 (name as written in text; tolerance NR)
growth_system: growth chamber; pots with vermiculite:soil (1:1); 16 h light/8 h dark; light intensity NR
timepoints_duration: single time point: 3 d after transfer to 5 °C
n_libraries: 6 by design (3 per condition); text also says 'nine runs'
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq (model NR); layout NR; 20-28 M clean reads per sample; 65-70% mapped to B73 RefGen_v3
accession: not found (text says data were submitted to NCBI SRA, accession number not retrievable from extracted text or web search)
key_finding: 5 °C for 3 d induced phospholipid and galactolipid synthesis genes; phosphatidic acid up, phosphatidylcholine down.
source_of_details: PMC full text; web search for accession (not found)
notes: Inconsistency between 'triplicate' and 'nine runs (three replicates for each treatment)'; check SRA run table

title: Transcriptomic Profiling of the Maize (Zea mays L.) Leaf Response to Abiotic Stresses at the Seedling Stage
growth_system: growth chamber; soil in 10 x 10 cm pots; 14 h light/10 h dark; light 250-300 (units unclear in text)
control_temperature: 28/22 °C day/night (one shared control for all four stresses)
other_factors: multi-stress panel vs shared control: salinity (200 mM NaCl, 2 h), drought (water withheld until third leaf expanded), heat (42 °C, 2 h)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq X Ten, PE150 (46-68 M raw reads per library); TopHat to B73 AGPv3
accession: SRP080208 (from PMC page, read through a web fetch; accession is blank in the extracted full text)
key_finding: 1,841 cold DEGs (888 up, 953 down) in B73 leaf; 167 DEGs shared by salinity, drought, heat and cold.
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession from PMC web page
notes: Cold exposure is short (2 h); no replicates beyond 2; verify accession on NCBI

title: RNA-seq Analysis of Cold and Drought Responsive Transcriptomes of Zea mays ssp. mexicana L.
genotypes: Zea mays ssp. mexicana L. (TEOSINTE) variety '8493'
tissue: whole seedling: roots, stems and leaves pooled
growth_system: climate-controlled box; soil substrate (Jiffy) in plastic boxes; 10 h light/14 h dark; 60% humidity; 25 °C before treatment
cold_treatments: 4 °C for 12 h (10 h light/14 h dark)
other_factors: drought treatment (20% PEG2000 in Hoagland solution, 3 h) vs same control
bio_reps: 2 (>=3 seedlings pooled per sample; each sample sequenced in two replicated runs)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, PE (read length NR); de novo Trinity assembly (no reference genome)
accession: GSE76939 (found via web search of OmicsDI; accession blank in extracted full text); PRJNA866469 also listed for same species and treatments (relation to GSE76939 unverified)
key_finding: Teosinte more responsive to cold (2,232 up, 817 down) than drought; ABA, trehalose and ICE1-CBF pathways up in both.
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession from web search
notes: Teosinte, flag; expression quantified against de novo assembly not B73; same RNA-seq data used to isolate ZmmICE1 (PMID 28189052, excluded)

title: Natural variation for gene expression responses to abiotic stress in maize
genotypes: B73; Mo17; Oh43; PH207; B37 (inbreds); F1 hybrids of B73 with three of the other inbreds (which three NR in abstract)
cold_treatments: cold (temperature and duration NR in abstract)
other_factors: heat stress also vs control; F1 hybrids for allele-specific expression (cis vs trans variation)
key_finding: Many genes respond differently to cold or heat between inbreds; cis-regulatory variation more common than trans.
source_of_details: abstract + web search; no PMC full text; publisher page not reachable
notes: Cold temperature, duration, replicates and accession need to be checked in the full text (Plant J 89:706-717); likely overlaps in design with Makarevitch 2015 B73 dataset but this was not confirmed

title: Differentially Regulated Orthologs in Sorghum and the Subgenomes of Maize

title: Transcriptome Analysis of Chilling-Imbibed Embryo Revealed Membrane Recovery Related Genes in Maize
stage_age: dry seed, then 2-3 h after imbibition start
growth_system: seeds imbibed between wet filter papers (chamber/incubator NR)
cold_treatments: imbibition at 5 °C for 2 h (LT2); then 25 °C for 1 h recovery (LT3)
control_temperature: 25 °C imbibition for 2 h (CK2) and 3 h (CK3); dry seed (CK0) as baseline
bio_reps: none reported (one RNA sample per condition)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (BGI), layout NR; ~15-21 M raw reads per sample; B73 RefGen_v2
key_finding: 5 °C imbibition mostly down-regulated plasma-membrane genes; 1 h recovery at 25 °C changed 873 genes incl. vesicle trafficking.
notes: No biological replication; first author Fei He; epub Jan 2017 (Front Plant Sci 7:1978)

title: Transcriptome Sequencing Identified Genes and Gene Ontologies Associated with Early Freezing Tolerance in Maize
genotypes: KR701 (freezing tolerant, 97.3% survival after -1 °C 3 h); Hei8834 (freezing sensitive, 5.0% survival); chosen from 30 elite inbreds adapted to northern China (Heilongjiang)
growth_system: incubator (RXZ-0450); peat:vermiculite:perlite 10:1:1; 25/20 °C; 14 h light/10 h dark
cold_treatments: -1 °C for 1 h before sampling (survival screen: -1 °C for 3 h then 3 d recovery at 25 °C)
control_temperature: 25/20 °C day/night; control sampled at 0 h before freezing
bio_reps: 2 per condition (1 for KR701 after freezing because of a technical failure)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000, PE101 (BGI); ~154 M reads total; TopHat to B73 AGPv3
accession: not found (text says deposited in NCBI SRA and GEO, accession number not retrievable from extracted text or web search)
other_omics: physiology (survival rate, electrolyte leakage); qRT-PCR validation of 30 genes
key_finding: 948 genes responded to freezing within line; more treatment DEGs in sensitive (852) than tolerant (439) line.
source_of_details: PMC full text; web search for accession (not found)
notes: Only one replicate for KR701 after freezing; text names both SRA and GEO without numbers
